macro.title: Global Sector Rotation
macro.body: The ongoing global trade tensions and geopolitical events are leading to a shift in sector rotations, with investors seeking safe-haven assets. This could impact the portfolio's holdings in tech and finance sectors.
macro.bull: A rotation into defensive sectors could benefit the portfolio's holdings in CDN Fin
macro.base: The sector rotation may have a neutral impact on the portfolio
macro.bear: A rotation out of tech could negatively impact the portfolio's holdings in NVDA and other tech stocks

macro.title: Inflation Expectations
macro.body: The recent increase in oil prices due to the US-Iran standoff may lead to higher inflation expectations, which could impact the portfolio's holdings in commodities and inflation-sensitive assets.
macro.bull: Higher inflation expectations could benefit the portfolio's holdings in commodities
macro.base: The impact of inflation expectations on the portfolio may be neutral
macro.bear: Higher inflation expectations could negatively impact the portfolio's holdings in bonds and other fixed-income assets

macro.title: FX Volatility
macro.body: The ongoing FX volatility, particularly between the USD and CAD, may impact the portfolio's holdings in USD-denominated assets.
macro.bull: A strengthening CAD could benefit the portfolio's holdings in CDN Fin
macro.base: The impact of FX volatility on the portfolio may be neutral
macro.bear: A weakening CAD could negatively impact the portfolio's holdings in USD-denominated assets

risks.title: Leverage Decay Risk
risks.body: The portfolio's high leverage exposure through FNGU, SPXL, and UDOW amplifies both gains and losses, increasing the risk of significant declines in the event of a market downturn.

risks.title: Single-Stock Risk
risks.body: The portfolio's significant holding in NVDA, which has had substantial growth, poses a risk if the stock experiences a sharp decline, impacting the overall portfolio performance.

risks.title: Sector Overlap Risk
risks.body: The portfolio's holdings in multiple tech stocks, including NVDA, TXF.TO, AVGO, and others, may increase the risk of sector-specific downturns impacting the portfolio's overall performance.
